title: SJTU-ReThinkLab 上海交通大学源思实验室
content:
我常年招收助理研究员、博后、博士生（特别是已经获得创智、中关村学院录取名额）、以及本科生参与实验室的大模型、智能体、科学智能、具身智能方面的前沿研究。实验室20余名毕业生和曾与我深入合作的毕业生已经在华五高校和人大、头部大厂核心部门（DeepSeek、字节等）、头部创业公司承担关键岗位。 
						
                        Looking for full-time assistant researcher, post-doc, phd candidates (especially those with National AI Institute offers incluiding Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen), initiative (high GPA/proved research capability -- but NOT must) undergraduates, who are interested in machine learning and applications like (but NOT limited to) autonomous driving, quantum AI, crypto, combinatorial solvers, EDA, dexterous hand, and AI4Science. Please send me resume via yanjunchi AT sjtu.edu.cn.
						
						
						Update: we are also working on something -1->0, 0->1: new (e.g. quantum/pde-inspired) LLM architecture, new scaling law, formal methods for inference and scale up. Try to talk to me! 
						Also feel free to contact me if you feel qualified to serve as a reviewer for TPAMI, PR, etc.
						
						
						Welcome to visit our x.com page

                    About SJTU-ReThinkLab
                
                Founded in April 2018 by Dr. Junchi Yan, the vision of SJTU-ReThinkLab (上海交通大学源思实验室) is to develop cutting-edge technolgies for solving the real-world problems whereby data-driven approach interleaved with domain knowledge can be well explored and applied. In particular, the recent years' research is focused on combinatorial optimization, PDE, quantum computing, and AI4Science.
